thread:
ryan (sales): Heads-up — FinBank POC saw spikes of 503s during live demo. ~120 qps, model=redwood-large-v1, 512 tokens. Demo started at ~15:00 PST, errors at 15:02. Need triage.

sara (support): Oof. Do we have request IDs or logs? Is it on hosted or dedicated preview?

ryan (sales): Both. reqs: fb-req-20260321-A, fb-req-20260321-B. Customer pretty nervous.

alex (infra): Quick check: autoscaler alert shows scale requested but nodes not added. infra-bot?

infra-bot: ALERT: autoscaler-delay pool=dedicated-us-west-2 requested=+3 added=0 reason=quota-check-failed (429).

james (eng-oncall): That fits. Control-plane rate-limited scale calls -> frontdoor returned 503s. Short-term fixes: lower batch_size on route, enable fallback model (redwood-medium-q8).

linda (solutions): Sales note — FinBank asked about reserved capacity earlier. If they commit we can pre-warm GPUs and avoid this. They also need KMS + SOC2 docs.

sara (support): I applied reduced batch_size (64->32) and toggled fallback. Errors dropped after ~30s.

alex (infra): I've filed INF-8742 to increase control-plane quota and add autoscaler retry/backoff. Also pushing a temporary quota bump.

ryan (sales): Can we get a short postmortem and a POC checklist for finance customers (concurrency knobs, fallback models, reserved capacity + pricing)? This helps the customer trust the setup.

sara (support): I'll draft PM and checklist — include recommended concurrency limits and how to request pre-warm. ETA tomorrow EOD.

linda (solutions): I'll send the security bundle and reserved capacity pricing to Ryan.

james (eng-oncall): Action items: INF-8742 (alex), postmortem & checklist (sara), security/pricing followup (linda/ryan).

infra-bot: TICKET INF-8742 created by alex at 2200001016

ryan (sales): Thanks all — demo resumed after fixes. Will reopen if they hit it again. :pray:
